what: SHA-256 of the input ZIPs compared with the checksums published in the brief (step 0.2)
method: SHA-256 of each whole ZIP file (same value as PowerShell Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256)
notes: ZIP checksums differ from the manifest.json checksums inside the ZIPs; each is compared only with its own published value.

g3b_primary_v1.zip has no published ZIP checksum: t41_nbaiot_extract_local.py checks its manifest.json SHA-256 (6ab99e86397242e219bfa1f8490d8e03b169ec87a092af80cb3e7aef1e61147b) and every member it reads.

After extraction, t41_botiot_train_features.py verifies every Bot-IoT package payload against its manifest (loader verify=True) and t43_botiot_analysis.py verifies the Full outputs it reads against output_checksums.json.
